core_obligations: Define the twist (proof lines 467-473): set the candidate invertible object to be the internal hom from one dualizing complex into the other.
Check invertibility (proof lines 473-478): affine locally this internal hom is invertible because the corresponding statement holds over a ring, using affine duality to compare the two situations.
Check the evaluation (proof lines 478-483): the evaluation map from the tensor product of the candidate object with the first complex to the second is an isomorphism by the same local reduction.
proof_roadmap: Define the candidate invertible object as the internal hom between the two complexes.
Verify that the evaluation map is an isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that two dualizing complexes on a locally Noetherian algebraic space differ by an invertible twist (statement lines 463-468). The proof (proof lines 469-483) defines the internal hom between the two complexes and verifies invertibility and the evaluation isomorphism by reduction to the corresponding statements over a ring via affine duality. H2: a complete short argument by local reduction.
